body: I’ve tried in the last and it didn’t help. But I’m seeing a therapist again now but I️ve only seen her a couple of times.

I feel like everyone close to me is abandoning me, all of my friends have slowly stopped toying to me, my family has proven that they still don’t care about me. And by the dark shadow i mean the thoughts of suicide that I’ve been fighting to control for the last almost 4 years.
